caveats: Argo Rollouts' own installation guide (docs/installation.md, master branch) states only: 'Check e2e testing file to see what the Kubernetes version is being fully tested,' pointing readers to a CI file rather than making a first-party compatibility statement, so this could not be used as compatibility evidence per the research rules.

Because installed_version_status is NOT_STATED and no statement covers Kubernetes 1.35 or 1.36 for any series, upgrade ordering relative to the EKS control-plane upgrade cannot be determined from project documentation; validate the recommended v1.10.0 upgrade against a real 1.35/1.36 cluster before rolling out broadly.

The chart used to install this component is the community-maintained argo-helm chart (argoproj/argo-helm), a separate repository from argo-rollouts itself; that project's own README notes CRDs are best applied manually via 'kubectl apply --server-side -k <chart>/crds' when not letting Helm manage them.

docs/installation.md's 'Upgrading Argo Rollouts' section gives only general operational guidance ('Delete the previous version of the controller and apply/install the new one'; in-flight Rollouts are paused and resumed by the new controller) with no version-specific migration notes for 1.6.x -> 1.10.x.
